搜尋字詞最多 256 字元，負責人與標籤最多 1000 字元，且不可包含空字元。: Search terms are limited to 256 characters, and owner and tag filters to 1000 characters. Null characters are not allowed.
基本搜尋包含負責人；內容搜尋包含五類紀錄的文字，不讀取或解密密碼。垃圾桶僅搜尋基: Basic search includes project owners. Content search covers text in all five record types, without reading or decrypting passwords. Trash searches project information only.
負責人與標籤以單一完整名稱比對，不區分大小寫；多個條件取交集。: Owner and tag filters match one complete name, case-insensitively. Multiple filters must all match.
垃圾桶不會自動清空。專案可復原；永久刪除須到管理頁逐一確認。: Trash is never emptied automatically. Projects can be restored; permanent deletion requires individual confirmation on the management page.
此專案已封存，仍可編輯與匯出；可從管理專案取消封存。: This project is archived. You can still edit and export it, or unarchive it in Manage project.
封存與垃圾桶不會改變專案的維護／結案／移交狀態，也不會刪除關聯資料。: Archiving and trashing do not change the project's maintenance, completed or handover status, or delete related records.
我已確認此專案及上述影響範圍。: I have reviewed this project and the impact described above.
垃圾桶中的專案只能管理與復原，無法瀏覽內容、編輯、匯出或讀取密碼。: Trashed projects can only be managed or restored. Their content, editing, exports and password access are blocked.
保留所有內容與加密密碼；復原後回到原本的使用中或已封存分類。: All content and encrypted passwords are retained. The project returns to its original active or archived collection.
永久刪除前必須成功建立完整 SQLite 復原點，可到資料備份下載。復原點包含所: A complete SQLite recovery snapshot must be created before permanent deletion and is available in Data backup. It contains all projects; restoring it replaces the whole database. This is not secure erasure: existing backups and SQLite storage may retain data.
刪除專案及全部 URL、備註、交接項目、環境設定與帳號密文；無法從垃圾桶復原。全: Deletes the project and all its URLs, notes, handover items, environment settings and encrypted account records. It cannot be restored from Trash. Global vault settings and other projects are unaffected.
將專案移回使用中列表，所有內容及狀態維持不變。: Return the project to the active collection without changing its content or status.

重設檢視、每頁筆數與篩選: Reset view, page size and filters
只有實際密碼是密文，其餘專案與帳號資料仍可讀取。請把備份放在安全位置，不要公開或: Only passwords are encrypted; other project and account data remain readable. Store backups securely and do not publish or casually forward them.
尚未設定密碼保管庫: The credential vault has not been set up
先驗證並比較內容，不會立即替換資料；確認頁有效 10 分鐘。: Validate and compare first without replacing data. The confirmation expires in 10 minutes.
驗證已通過，目前資料尚未替換。: Validation passed. Current data have not been replaced.
這是整個資料庫替換，不是專案合併。所有使用中、已封存及垃圾桶專案、帳號、保管庫與: This replaces the entire database; it does not merge projects. Active, archived and trashed projects, accounts, vault and export settings will all be replaced.
預覽不會解密密碼，也不能證明原主密碼可用；還原後保管庫會鎖定，仍須備份所屬的原主: Preview does not decrypt passwords or verify the original master password. Restoring locks the vault; the backup's original master password is still required.
若目前資料在預覽後變更，系統會拒絕替換並要求重新預覽。取消、逾時或重啟後須重新上: Changes to the current database invalidate this confirmation. Upload again after cancellation, expiration or a server restart.
備份允許含密碼匯出，還原後會沿用這項設定；實際匯出仍須解鎖並逐次確認。: This backup permits password exports. The setting will be restored, but each export still requires unlocking and explicit confirmation.
我了解這會取代全部資料，並先建立還原前復原點。: I understand that all data will be replaced after creating a pre-restore recovery point.
取消預覽並移除暫存檔: Cancel preview and remove temporary upload
只設定候選條件，不會自動刪除任何檔案。: These settings only select candidates. No files are automatically deleted.
至少保留最新份數: Keep at least the newest copies
最短保留天數（0 為不限）: Minimum age in days (0: no age restriction)
僅在選擇自訂時套用數量與天數；同時保留最新 N 份及未滿指定天數的檔案。每次最多: Count and age apply only in custom mode. Both the newest N copies and younger files are protected. Each cleanup is limited to 100 files.
只處理此資料目錄的還原前、永久刪除前與主密碼更換前復原點；不處理遷移快照、下載備: Only pre-restore, pre-deletion and pre-password-change recovery points in this data directory are eligible. Migration snapshots, downloaded backups and unknown files are excluded. Settings are stored in backups/retention-policy.json and are not overwritten by a database restore.
本次將永久移除 {count} 份復原點，約 {size} MB。: This will permanently remove {count} recovery points, approximately {size} MB.
清理不能由程式復原。請先把需要保留的檔案下載到其他安全位置；不會刪除清單以外的檔: Cleanup cannot be undone by the app. Download anything you need to another secure location first. Files outside this list will not be deleted.
我已核對檔名並保留需要的備份，了解清理後無法復原。: I have reviewed the filenames and saved the backups I need. I understand that cleanup cannot be undone.
目前沒有符合條件的復原點，未刪除任何檔案。: No recovery points meet the criteria. No files were deleted.
清理未完成，請保留其餘復原點並檢查檔案權限。: Cleanup is incomplete. Keep the remaining recovery points and check file permissions.
備份預覽已滿，請先取消其他預覽，或等待 10 分鐘後重試。: Backup preview capacity is full. Cancel another preview or wait 10 minutes and try again.
預覽已失效或不屬於此瀏覽器，請重新預覽。: This preview expired or belongs to another browser. Create a new preview.
復原點目錄不可使用連結，請先檢查備份位置。: Recovery-point directories cannot be links. Check the backup location first.
請選擇有效的復原點保留策略。: Select a valid recovery-point retention policy.
至少保留 1 至 500 份；最短保留天數為 0 至 3650，0 表示不限天數: Keep 1 to 500 copies and set the minimum age to 0 to 3650 days. Zero means no age restriction.
保留策略無法讀取，已停止清理；請保留復原點並檢查設定檔。: Retention settings cannot be read. Cleanup is disabled; keep recovery points and check the settings file.
復原點超過 2000 份，請先備份並以離線方式整理。: There are more than 2000 recovery points. Back them up and organize them offline.
復原點已變更，本次未清理，請重新預覽。: Recovery points changed. Nothing was cleaned up; create a new preview.
保留範圍內沒有通過驗證的復原點，請先建立並保存有效備份。: No recovery point in the retained set passes validation. Create and preserve a valid recovery point before cleanup.
目前資料已在預覽後變更，尚未替換；請重新預覽並確認。: The current database changed after preview. It has not been replaced; preview and confirm again.
請勾選替換確認，並輸入 RESTORE 後再還原。: Check the replacement acknowledgment and type RESTORE before restoring.
預覽檔案已變更，尚未替換；請重新上傳。: The preview upload changed. Data have not been replaced; upload again.
請勾選清理確認，並輸入 DELETE 後再清理。: Check the cleanup acknowledgment and type DELETE before deleting files.
預覽作業失敗，資料尚未變更。請確認磁碟空間與檔案權限。: Preview failed without changing data. Check disk space and file permissions.
保留策略未儲存，請確認磁碟空間與檔案權限。: Retention settings were not saved. Check disk space and file permissions.
只翻譯文件標題與欄位，不翻譯專案內容。: Only document headings and field labels are translated, not project content.
專案名稱、狀態、負責人與標籤一律保留；請至少選擇一個章節。: Project name, status, owner and tags are always included. Select at least one section.
預設不包含實際密碼。含密碼匯出仍須允許政策、解鎖保管庫及再次確認。: Actual passwords are excluded by default. Sensitive exports still require policy approval, an unlocked vault and explicit confirmation.
我確認此檔案可能包含實際密碼，並會安全保管。: I acknowledge that this file may contain actual passwords and will store it securely.
請選擇有效的文件語言及至少一個匯出章節。: Choose a valid document language and at least one export section.
套用模板會取代目前的 Markdown 草稿，確定繼續？: Applying this template will replace the current Markdown draft. Continue?
預覽會在新分頁開啟，不會儲存備註。模板可從獨立編輯工具複製。: Preview opens in a new tab without saving the note. Copy templates from the standalone workspace.
預覽不會儲存；請勿在備註輸入實際密碼。Mermaid 目前以程式碼顯示。: Preview does not save. Never enter actual passwords in notes. Mermaid is currently displayed as code.
此處只供編寫與預覽；請複製內容回專案儲存，關閉頁面不會保存草稿。: This workspace only edits and previews. Copy the content back to a project to save it; closing the page does not retain drafts.
預覽失敗，草稿已保留，請稍後重試。: Preview failed. Your draft is retained; try again later.
預覽內容不可超過 100000 個字元或包含空字元。: Preview must not exceed 100000 characters or contain null characters.
必須知道目前主密碼，不能用來重設遺失的密碼。: You must know the current master password. This cannot reset a forgotten password.
系統會先驗證目前主密碼並保存完整復原點，再以新的 salt／金鑰重新加密全部帳號: Your current master password is verified and a full recovery copy is saved before all account passwords are re-encrypted with a new salt and key. All sessions are locked afterwards.
更換前的備份仍須使用舊主密碼，不能由新主密碼解鎖。更換不會撤銷已下載的備份或明文: Older backups still require the old master password, not the new one. Changing it cannot revoke downloaded backups or plaintext exports. Keep both passwords securely outside ProjMemo.
我已了解舊備份須使用舊主密碼，並確認更換後全部連線會鎖定。: I understand that older backups require the old password and that all sessions will be locked after changing it.
主密碼已更換，所有舊解鎖連線已撤銷。請使用新主密碼重新解鎖。: Master password changed. All previous unlocked sessions have been revoked. Unlock again with your new master password.
請先確認主密碼更換及舊備份注意事項。: Acknowledge the password change and older-backup requirements first.
兩次輸入的新主密碼不一致: The new master passwords do not match
主密碼文字格式不正確: The master password contains invalid text
新主密碼不可與目前主密碼相同: The new master password must differ from the current password
目前主密碼錯誤，未進行更換: The current master password is incorrect. Nothing was changed
主密碼更換未完成。請保留復原點，確認資料狀態後再試；如需復原，請前往資料備份。: The master password change did not complete. Keep the recovery copy and check the data before retrying. Use Backup & restore if recovery is needed.
保管庫主密碼更換中，請稍後再試。: The vault master password is being changed. Try again shortly.
